ps.en: In modern media, analysts warn against relying on purely [[subjective]] opinions when evaluating public policies. A well-known organization agreed to [[sponsor]] a civic forum to prevent fake news from [[spoiling|spoil]] public trust. Their primary goal was to [[spread]] reliable data and provide a constructive [[spur]] to national reform.
ps.zh: 在现代媒体中，分析人士警告说，在评估公共政策时不要依赖纯粹的主观观点。一家知名机构同意赞助一个公民论坛，以防止假新闻破坏公众信任。他们的主要目标是传播可靠数据，并对国家改革提供建设性刺激。

ps.en: Undercover agents continued to [[spy]] on hostile networks, evaluating whether the government could maintain political [[stability]]. Maintaining a [[stable]] economic climate allowed executive [[staff]] to step onto the national [[stage]] with confidence.
ps.zh: 卧底特工继续侦察敌对网络，评估政府能否维持政治稳定。保持稳定的经济气候让执行员工能够有信心走上国家舞台。

ps.en: A sudden political [[twist]] forced negotiators to dismiss [[trivial]] complaints and [[try]] a bold new diplomatic approach. The stock market began to [[tumble]] during a [[turbulent]] quarter, but leaders managed to [[turn]] the situation around.
ps.zh: 政治上的突发转折迫使谈判代表驳回琐碎的控诉，并尝试一种大胆的新外交方法。股市在动荡的季度中开始跌倒，但领导人成功地扭转了局势。

ps.en: Boosting corporate [[turnover]] significantly, executives classified each [[type]] of risk using a [[typical]] pattern of market fluctuations. They called for a [[voluntary]] agreement where every [[volunteer]] was asked to [[vote]] against corrupt measures, ensuring that [[vulgar]] commercial abuses did not hurt [[vulnerable]] social groups.
ps.zh: 在大幅提升企业营业额的同时，高管们利用市场波动的典型模式对每种风险类型进行了分类。他们呼吁达成一项自愿协议，要求每位志愿者投票反对腐败措施，确保粗俗的商业滥用不会伤害脆弱的社会群体。

ps.en: The [[author]] of the compliance guide consulted the highest legal [[authority]] to establish [[auxiliary]] standards. They realized that emergency funds would not [[avail]] unless immediately made [[available]] to regional clinics. A prominent legal [[critic]] voiced sharp [[criticism]], offering [[critical]] assessments of past negligence.
ps.zh: 合规指南的作者咨询了最高法律权威以确立辅助标准。他们意识到，除非立即提供给区域诊所，否则应急资金将不起作用。一位著名的法律批评家发表了尖锐的批评，对过去的疏忽提出了关键评估。

ps.en: Auditors chose to [[criticize]] administrative flaws while recognizing that a [[crucial]] inquiry was needed to [[culminate]] in a comprehensive trial to identify the true [[culprit]] behind financial fraud.
ps.zh: 审计人员选择批评行政缺陷，同时认识到需要展开一项关键调查，以在全面的审判中告终，指认出财务欺诈背后的真正罪犯。

ps.en: Local leaders sought to [[cultivate]] a rich civic [[culture]] by promoting [[dual]] educational languages. Resolving [[dubious]] claims regarding [[due]] taxes, the company promised to build [[durable]] public infrastructure for the long [[duration]] of the project. Fulfilling their public [[duty]], they sparked [[dynamic]] economic activity across the region.
ps.zh: 当地领导人试图通过推广双语教育来培养丰富的公民文化。解决关于到期应缴税款的可疑主张，该公司承诺在项目的长期持续期间建设耐用的公共基础设施。履行他们的公共职责，他们在全地区引发了动态的经济活动。

ps.en: Environmentalists feared that endangered species might become [[extinct]] if forest fires were not quickly [[extinguished|extinguish]] before experts could [[introduce]] green tech.
ps.zh: 环保主义者担心，如果在专家引入绿色科技前森林火灾不被快速扑灭，濒危物种可能会灭绝。

ps.en: The [[introduction]] of a strategic campaign aimed to [[invest]] capital and boost foreign [[investment]] in sustainable agriculture. Special agents were assigned to [[investigate]] a [[mysterious]] criminal network, treating the case as a deep [[mystery]] rather than an ancient [[myth]].
ps.zh: 战略运动的引入旨在投入资金并促进外资对可持续农业的投资。特别特工被指派去调查一个神秘的犯罪网络，将此案视为深奥的谜团，而不是古代的神话。

ps.en: Guided by [[noble]] ethics and a strict social [[norm]], they worked toward the [[normalization]] of [[normal]] operational standards while fostering [[mutual]] respect among agencies. Investigators took careful [[note]] of a troubling [[notion]] that corporate fraud was being hidden from the [[public]]. The [[publication]] of their findings caused widespread alarm.
ps.zh: 在高尚道德和严格社会规范的指导下，他们致力于使正常运营标准常态化，同时培养机构间的相互尊重。调查人员仔细记录了一种令人不安的观念，即公司欺诈正向公众隐瞒。他们调查结果的出版引发了广泛警觉。

ps.en: The widespread [[publicity]] forced media outlets to [[publish]] the whole truth, leading to a positive [[result]]. Showing that the [[resultant]] reform would [[resume]] public trust, the evidence failed to [[reveal]] any secret attempts at [[revenge]].
ps.zh: 广泛的宣传迫使媒体机构公布全部事实，带来了积极的结果。表明产生的改革将恢复公众信任，证据未能揭示任何秘密报复尝试。

ps.en: Instead, a shocking [[revelation]] showed that state [[revenue]] was used properly to [[supply]] equipment and [[support]] research. Lawmakers [[suppose]] that clear intent to [[suppress]] illegal trade will [[supplement]] healthcare funds and maintain [[supreme]] standards across a [[systematic]] public [[system]].
ps.zh: 相反，一项惊人的揭示表明国家财政收入被妥善用于供应设备和支持研究。立法者假设镇压非法交易的明确意图将补充医疗资金，并在一个系统的公共体系中维持至高无上的标准。

words.dif: subjective 强调出于个人主观感受或偏见；objective 强调客观公正。
words.pat: Evaluating artistic merit often involves subjective personal taste.
words.patZh: 评估艺术价值往往涉及主观的个人品味。

c: spoil the appetite 破坏食欲
spoil a child 宠坏孩子
words.dif: spoil 可指损坏物品、毁掉心情，也可指过度溺爱溺宠孩子。
words.pat: Extremely high humidity can spoil sensitive electronic components quickly.
words.patZh: 极高的湿度会迅速损坏敏感的电子元件。

words.exam: 赞助商；主办者；赞助；发起
c: sponsor an event 赞助一项活动
words.dif: sponsor 指为活动出资赞助的厂商，或在议会中发起提案者。
words.pat: The international firm agreed to sponsor the educational scholarship program.
words.patZh: 这家国际公司同意赞助该教育奖学金项目。

words.dif: spread 侧重从中心向四周扩展分布、传播蔓延。
words.pat: Social media enables news to spread across the globe in seconds.
words.patZh: 社交媒体使新闻能在数秒内传播到全球。

c: spur economic growth 刺激经济增长
on the spur of the moment 一时冲动
words.dif: spur 原指骑马的马刺，引申为推动某事加速发展的刺激激励物。
words.pat: Tax cuts were introduced to spur private investment in clean energy.
words.patZh: 出台减税政策旨在刺激对清洁能源的私人投资。

words.dif: spy 指暗中刺探情报的人员，或执行暗中侦察监视。
words.pat: Intelligence agencies worked to stop enemy agents spying on secret facilities.
words.patZh: 情报机构致力于阻止敌方特工侦察秘密设施。

words.dif: stability 强调结构、情绪或局势处于平稳牢固状态。
words.pat: Maintaining social stability is essential for sustainable economic development.
words.patZh: 维持社会稳定对于可持续经济发展至关重要。

words.dif: stable 指牢固不易倒塌改变的，或性格情绪沉稳冷静。
words.pat: Doctors reported that the patient was in a stable condition after surgery.
words.patZh: 医生报告说手术后患者处于稳定状况。

words.exam: 全体职工；工作人员；配备人员
c: staffed by 由…配备工作人员
words.dif: staff 作集合名词指机构中的全体工作人员团队。
words.pat: The hospital hired extra staff to handle the seasonal flu outbreak.
words.patZh: 医院雇佣了额外员工来应对季节性流感爆发。

fam: staging n. 上演；舞台效果
words.dif: stage 既指表演的舞台，也指发展过程中的某一特定阶段。
words.pat: The negotiations have reached a critical stage where consensus is required.
words.patZh: 谈判已到达需要达成共识的关键阶段。

c: twist of fate 命运的转折
words.dif: twist 强调用力扭拧或剧情局势发生的意想不到的急转折。
words.pat: An unexpected twist in the investigation revealed the real culprit.
words.patZh: 调查中意想不到的转折揭示了真正的罪犯。

words.dif: trivial 强调毫无价值、微不足道、不值得耗费精力关注。
words.pat: Do not waste precious meeting time discussing trivial administrative details.
words.patZh: 不要把宝贵的会议时间浪费在讨论琐碎的行政细节上。

c: give it a try 试一试
words.dif: try 泛指付出努力试图完成某事或试用。
words.pat: Researchers will try a new combination of therapies to boost recovery.
words.patZh: 研究人员将尝试一种新的疗法组合来促进康复。

words.dif: tumble 侧重失去平衡突然跌倒或价格指数猛烈暴跌。
words.pat: Share values began to tumble following the announcement of poor earnings.
words.patZh: 在宣布业绩惨淡后股票价值开始暴跌。

words.dif: turbulent 描写局势骚乱不安或水流气流剧烈翻腾。
words.pat: The company managed to maintain profit margins throughout a turbulent decade.
words.patZh: 该公司在整个动荡的十年中成功维持了利润率。

words.dif: turn 侧重方向的改变、局势的转折或按顺序轮流。
words.pat: Strategic innovation helped the brand turn the crisis into an opportunity.
words.patZh: 战略创新帮助该品牌将危机扭转为机遇。

words.dif: turnover 特指企业一定时期内的总销售营业额或员工换岗率。
words.pat: High staff turnover can negatively affect team productivity and morale.
words.patZh: 高员工流动率会给团队生产力和士气带来负面影响。

c: type a letter 打一封信
words.dif: type 指具有共同特征的一类事物，或在键盘上打字。
words.pat: What type of technical support does the software provider guarantee?
words.patZh: 软件供应商保证提供哪种类型的技术支持？

c: typical example 典型特征/例子
be typical of 是…典型的
words.dif: typical 强调具备某一类别全部代表性特征。
words.pat: Heavy rainfall is typical of the tropical climate during summer.
words.patZh: 强降雨是夏季热带气候的典型特征。

words.dif: voluntary 强调出自个人自由意志而非受胁迫规定。
words.pat: Participation in the wellness program is entirely voluntary for all staff.
words.patZh: 所有员工参与该健康项目完全是自愿的。

c: volunteer to help 自愿帮忙
words.dif: volunteer 指无偿自愿提供服务的人，或主动承担任务。
words.pat: Many students volunteer at the local shelter during winter holidays.
words.patZh: 许多学生在寒假期间在当地救助站当志愿者。

words.dif: vote 指通过划票、举手等方式表达正式选举或表决意愿。
words.pat: Members met to vote on the proposed amendments to the charter.
words.patZh: 成员们开会表决拟议的章程修正案。

words.dif: vulgar 强调缺乏教养、言行粗鲁不雅致或趣味低级。
words.pat: The critic condemned the film for its reliance on vulgar humor.
words.patZh: 影评人指责该电影依赖粗俗的幽默。

words.dif: vulnerable 强调容易受到物理伤害、攻击或精神创伤打击。
words.pat: Coastal regions are particularly vulnerable to extreme climate events.
words.patZh: 沿海地区特别容易受到极端气候事件的伤害。

c: author a report 撰写报告
words.dif: author 指书籍文章的著作者，或某项计划方案的始作俑者。
words.pat: The author spent five years researching archives before publishing the biography.
words.patZh: 作者在出版该传记前花了五年时间研究档案馆。

c: local authority 当地政府/当局
an authority on 某方面的权威
words.dif: authority 指合法的行政统治权力，或某一领域的泰斗专家。
words.pat: She is recognized as a leading authority on international maritime law.
words.patZh: 她被公认为国际海洋法领域的顶尖权威。

words.dif: auxiliary 强调起协助补充或备用保障作用的设备人员。
words.pat: The hospital switched to auxiliary generators when the main grid failed.
words.patZh: 当主电网故障时医院切换到了备用发电机。

c: to no avail 毫无效果/徒劳
words.dif: avail 常用短语 to no avail 表示徒劳，avail oneself of 表示利用机会。
words.pat: All emergency efforts to restore power were to no avail during the blizzard.
words.patZh: 在暴风雪期间恢复供电的所有紧急努力均告徒劳。

words.dif: available 指物品可被取得使用，或人员有时间空闲。
words.pat: Fresh clean water must be made readily available to all disaster victims.
words.patZh: 必须向所有灾民随时提供新鲜干净的饮用水。

c: harsh critic 严厉的批评者
words.dif: critic 指专职撰写评论分析的评论家，或提出反对批评的人。
words.pat: The theater critic praised the lead actor's powerful dramatic performance.
words.patZh: 戏剧评论家赞扬了主角强有力的戏剧表演。

words.dif: critical 侧重极其重要决定成败，或带有审查批判态度。
words.pat: Developing critical thinking skills is a fundamental goal of higher education.
words.patZh: 培养批判性思维技能是高等教育的根本目标。

c: constructive criticism 建设性的批评
words.dif: criticism 指提出的反对批评意见，或对艺术作品的学术评论。
words.pat: The management welcomed constructive criticism to improve customer service.
words.patZh: 管理层欢迎建设性的批评意见以改进客户服务。

c: criticize sb for 因…批评某人
words.dif: criticize 指公开指出错误缺点并给以指责或评价。
words.pat: It is easy to criticize policy decisions after knowing the final outcome.
words.patZh: 在获知最终结果后去批评政策决定总是容易的。

c: crucial decision 决定性的决定
words.dif: crucial 强调在转折关头起决定成败的生死攸关作用。
words.pat: Timely international aid was crucial to preventing a humanitarian disaster.
words.patZh: 及时的国际援助对于防止人道主义灾难至关重要。

c: culminate in 以…达到高潮/告终
words.dif: culminate 搭配 in 表示经过长期积累发展后最终达到高潮终点。
words.pat: Years of rigorous research will culminate in a groundbreaking publication.
words.patZh: 多年严谨的研究将以一份突破性著作的出版告终。

words.exam: 罪犯；问题的起因/肇事者
c: catch the culprit 抓获罪犯
words.dif: culprit 既指犯罪的罪犯，也指导致不良后果的幕后肇事元凶。
words.pat: Deforestation is the primary culprit behind severe regional soil erosion.
words.patZh: 滥砍滥伐是严重区域水土流失背后的主要罪魁祸首。

words.dif: cultivate 指耕耘土地，或通过用心灌溉培育人才品性技巧。
words.pat: Universities aim to cultivate creative talent capable of solving complex problems.
words.patZh: 大学旨在培养能够解决复杂问题的创新人才。

words.dif: culture 指人类社会创造的精神物质文化，或生物细菌培养。
words.pat: Understanding a foreign culture requires open-mindedness and empathy.
words.patZh: 理解外域文化需要开放的心态与共情力。

words.dif: dual 强调兼具两种功能、身份或由两部分组成。
words.pat: The manager plays a dual role as both technical leader and mentor.
words.patZh: 该经理扮演着技术领导者与导师的双重角色。

words.exam: 怀疑的；可疑的；不确定的
c: be dubious about 对…表示怀疑
words.dif: dubious 强调合法性真实性令人生疑、不可靠。
words.pat: Financial regulators questioned the firm's dubious accounting practices.
words.patZh: 金融监管机构质疑该公司可疑的会计做法。

words.exam: 预期的；到期的；应得的；应付款
c: in due course 在适当的时候
words.dif: due 表示到期应付的、预期的，短语 due to 表示由于。
words.pat: The final research report is due on the last Friday of the month.
words.patZh: 最终研究报告预定于本月最后一个星期五交稿。

words.dif: durable 强调经久耐用、能经受长期磨损消耗。
words.pat: Constructing durable infrastructure reduces long-term maintenance costs.
words.patZh: 建设耐用的基础设施可以降低长期维护成本。

c: for the duration of 在…期间
short duration 短暂持续时间
words.dif: duration 强点某一状态或事件在时间轴上持续的长度。
words.pat: Passengers must remain seated for the entire duration of the flight.
words.patZh: 在整个飞行持续期间乘客必须保持就座。

words.dif: duty 指道德或法律上必须履行的职责，或海关进口税。
words.pat: It is the fiduciary duty of directors to act in the best interest of shareholders.
words.patZh: 董事为了股东的最大利益行事是其法定信托职责。

words.exam: 充满活力的；动态的；动力
c: dynamic market 动态/具活力的市场
words.dif: dynamic 强调充满活力能量、不断变化发展。
words.pat: Adapting to a dynamic market environment requires agile leadership.
words.patZh: 适应动态的市场环境需要敏捷的领导力。

words.exam: 灭绝的；绝迹的；熄灭了的
words.dif: extinct 指物种灭绝或火山熄灭、风俗绝迹。
words.pat: Without protection, many endangered species will become extinct within decades.
words.patZh: 如果没有保护，许多濒危物种将在几十年内灭绝。

c: extinguish a fire 扑灭火灾
words.dif: extinguish 侧重扑灭火火焰，或消灭希望权利。
words.pat: Firefighters worked through the night to extinguish the raging forest fire.
words.patZh: 消防员整夜工作以扑灭肆虐的森林火灾。

c: introduce a policy 引入一项政策
introduce sb to 介绍某人给…
words.dif: introduce 指向他人介绍，或向机构引进新技术政策。
words.pat: The firm plans to introduce automated workflows to increase efficiency.
words.patZh: 该公司计划引入自动化工作流来提高效率。

words.dif: introduction 指书本的导论前言，或新技术的引进使用。
words.pat: The introduction of solar power reduced reliance on fossil fuels.
words.patZh: 太阳能的引入降低了对化石燃料的依赖。

c: invest time in 在…上投入时间
words.dif: invest 搭配 in，指投入资金、金钱或精力和时间。
words.pat: Governments should invest heavily in public education and research.
words.patZh: 政府应当在公共教育与科研上加大投资。

c: return on investment 投资回报率
words.dif: investment 指投放资金的行为或所投入的资本额。
words.pat: Attracting foreign direct investment is a key goal for regional development.
words.patZh: 吸引外商直接投资是区域发展的关键目标。

c: investigate a crime 调查犯罪
investigate the cause 调查原因
words.dif: investigate 强调为了查明真相而有条理地深入调查细节。
words.pat: Authorities formed a special committee to investigate the security breach.
words.patZh: 当局成立了一个特别委员会来调查安全漏洞。

words.dif: mutual 强调两者之间双向对等的相互作用或共同享有。
words.pat: Successful partnership relies on mutual trust and transparent communication.
words.patZh: 成功的合作伙伴关系建立在相互信任与透明沟通之上。

words.dif: mysterious 强调充满神秘色彩、难以用常理解释。
words.pat: Detectives looked into the mysterious disappearance of the valuable artwork.
words.patZh: 侦探们调查了那件价值连城的艺术品的神秘失踪。

c: solve a mystery 解开谜团
remain a mystery 仍是个谜
words.dif: mystery 指令人困惑不解的事物、秘密或悬疑小说。
words.pat: The exact origin of the ancient text remains a scientific mystery.
words.patZh: 这篇古代文献的准确起源仍是一个科学谜团。

c: dispel the myth 消除误解/神话
words.dif: myth 可指古代神话故事，也可指广为流传但并不属实的错误观念。
words.pat: Modern science helped dispel the popular myth about diet pills.
words.patZh: 现代科学有助于消除关于减肥药的流行误解。

words.dif: noble 侧重指品格高尚崇高，或出身高贵的贵族阶层。
words.pat: Fighting against systemic injustice is a truly noble cause.
words.patZh: 同系统性不公作斗争是一项真正高尚的事业。

c: above the norm 高于常规标准
words.dif: norm 指社会普遍认可遵循的道德行为准则或平均标准。
words.pat: Working remotely has become the accepted norm for tech companies.
words.patZh: 远程办公已成为科技公司普遍接受的规范。

words.exam: 正常的；普通标准的；正常状态
c: back to normal 恢复正常
words.dif: normal 与 abnormal（异常的）相对，指符合常规标准状态。
words.pat: Business operations returned to normal following the end of the strike.
words.patZh: 罢工结束后商业运营恢复了正常。

c: normalization of relations 关系正常化
words.dif: normalization 指从异常无序状态恢复到正常轨道的规制过程。
words.pat: Diplomats worked for the normalization of diplomatic ties between the two nations.
words.patZh: 外交官们致力于两国间外交关系的正常化。

words.exam: 笔记；便条；音符；注意；记录
words.dif: note 作动词指留心注意到或做记录；作名词指便条音符。
words.pat: Please note that the deadline for submission is non-negotiable.
words.patZh: 请注意到提交截止日期是不容谈判的。

c: reject the notion 拒绝这种观念
preconceived notion 先入为主的观念
words.dif: notion 侧重指头脑中形成的主观看法、想法或模糊印象。
words.pat: He challenged the outdated notion that failure equals defeat.
words.patZh: 他挑战了那种失败即等于彻底被打败的过时观念。

words.dif: public 与 private（私人的）相对，指面向大众平民开放的。
words.pat: The government has a duty to protect public health during an outbreak.
words.patZh: 政府在疫情爆发期间有职责保护公共健康。

c: date of publication 出版日期
words.dif: publication 指书籍期刊等印刷发表的过程或印出的出版物。
words.pat: The professor celebrated the publication of her new textbook.
words.patZh: 教授庆祝了她的新教科书的出版。

words.dif: publicity 强调通过媒体报道引起的公众关注、知名度或促销活动。
words.pat: The event generated massive publicity for the environmental charity.
words.patZh: 该活动为环保慈善机构赢得了巨大的公众关注。

c: publish a report 发表报告
words.dif: publish 指印发图书，或向社会公众正式公布研究数据报告。
words.pat: The laboratory will publish its findings in a peer-reviewed journal.
words.patZh: 实验室将在同行评审期刊上发表其研究发现。

words.dif: result 搭配 in 表示引发某结果，搭配 from 表示由某原因造成。
words.pat: Neglecting routine maintenance can result in sudden mechanical breakdown.
words.patZh: 忽视常规维护可能会导致突发的机械故障。

words.dif: resultant 侧重因某一具体事件直接引发或导致的后效。
words.pat: The drought and resultant crop failure led to a severe food shortage.
words.patZh: 干旱和随之产生的作物减产导致了严重的粮食短缺。

words.dif: resume 动词指中断后重新开始；名词读音不同指个人履历简历。
words.pat: Flights will resume normal schedules once the fog clears up.
words.patZh: 一旦大雾散去航班将恢复正常时刻表。

c: reveal the truth 揭示真相
words.dif: reveal 侧重揭开原本隐瞒、不为人知的秘密真相或事实。
words.pat: The audit failed to reveal any evidence of illegal transactions.
words.patZh: 审计未能揭示出任何非法交易的证据。

words.exam: 揭示；透露；出乎意料的事
c: startling revelation 令人震惊的揭露
revelation of truth 真相的揭示
words.dif: revelation 指被揭开公布的惊人事实真相或神圣启示。
words.pat: The journalist's book was packed with shocking revelations about corporate greed.
words.patZh: 记者的书里装满了关于公司贪婪的令人震惊的揭露。

c: take revenge on 对…进行报复
words.dif: revenge 强调出于个人怨恨不满而进行的反击报复。
words.pat: Seeking personal revenge will only perpetuate the violent feud.
words.patZh: 寻求个人报复只会使暴力宿怨持续下去。

words.dif: revenue 特指国家政府的财政税收或公司的营业总收入。
words.pat: The government reported a significant increase in annual tax revenue.
words.patZh: 政府报告说年度税收收入有了显著增长。

c: supply and demand 供求关系
words.dif: supply 指向需要者提供所需物资装备，或经济供求关系中的供给。
words.pat: The charity worked to supply medical aid to refugees in the camp.
words.patZh: 慈善机构致力于向营地里的难民提供医疗援助。

words.exam: 支撑；支持；资助；供养；支持者
c: support a candidate 支持某候选人
words.dif: support 强调用体能、金钱或情感道德上撑住、给以有力后盾。
words.pat: Strong public support enabled the government to pass the healthcare bill.
words.patZh: 强大的公众支持使政府能够通过该医疗法案。

words.exam: 猜想；假定；认为；（be supposed to）应当
c: be supposed to 应当/被期望
words.dif: suppose 表示根据已有迹象进行推测猜想，短语 be supposed to 表示应当履行的职责。
words.pat: Employees are supposed to complete safety training before using the machinery.
words.patZh: 员工被要求在操作该机械前完成安全培训。

c: suppress a rebellion 镇压叛乱
words.dif: suppress 强调凭借武力、权威或意志强行镇压、封锁或抑制。
words.pat: The dictator used military force to suppress civilian protests across the nation.
words.patZh: 独裁者使用军事力量强行镇压全国范围内的平民抗议。

c: supplement income 增加/补充收入
words.dif: supplement 指为了弥补不足而额外增加的补充物或增刊。
words.pat: Many elderly people take calcium supplements to maintain strong bone health.
words.patZh: 许多老年人服用钙补充剂以维持强健骨骼健康。

words.dif: supreme 强调在权力、地位、品质或重要性上达到最高顶点。
words.pat: The Supreme Court will review the constitutionality of the lower court ruling.
words.patZh: 最高法院将审查下级法院判决的合宪性。

words.dif: system 指按特定规则有机组合在一起的整体系统制度。
words.pat: Reforming the public education system is vital for future economic growth.
words.patZh: 改革公共教育体系对于未来的经济增长至关重要。

c: systematic analysis 系统化的分析
words.dif: systematic 强调做事有计划、有条理、按步骤系统推进。
words.pat: A systematic review of internal controls prevented further financial loss.
words.patZh: 对内部控制系统的审查防止了进一步的财务损失。
